description: Use this when the user asks to follow a drug, gene, process, disease or other entity on AgingResearch.News, so its new papers reach them in For you and the daily follow email. Takes a type and key from find_entities or get_entity.

key.description: The entity's key within its type, such as rapamycin.

type.description: The entity's type, as find_entities or get_entity gives it.
